items.description: Information about the secret finding locations.

isResourceDeleted.description: If true, the resource in which the secret was found was deleted.

leakedBy.description: The ID of the user who exposed the secret.

location.description: The location where the secret was found.

occurrences.description: The number of times the secret occurs in the location.

parentResourceId.description: The parent resource's unique ID. If the resource is a request, folder, or example, this value is a collection ID. If the resource is a collection, globals, or environment, this is the resource's ID.

resourceId.description: The unique ID of the resource where the secret was detected.

resourceType.description: The type of resource in which the secret was detected.

detectedAt.description: The date and time at which the secret was detected.

url.description: The URL to the resource that contains the secret.

activityFeed.description: The history of the secret's resolution status changes.

resolvedAt.description: The date and time at which the resolution status was last updated.

resolvedBy.description: The ID of the user that updated the secret's resolution status.

status.description:
The secret's current resolution status:
- `ACTIVE` — The secret is active.
- `FALSE_POSITIVE` — The discovered secret is not an actual secret.
- `REVOKED` — The secret is valid, but the user rotated their key to resolve the issue.
- `ACCEPTED_RISK` — The Secret Scanner found the secret, but user accepts the risk of publishing it.

cursor.description: The pointer to the first record of the set of paginated results.

limit.description: The maximum number of rows to return in the response.

nextCursor.description: The Base64-encoded value that points to the next record in the results set.

total.description: The total number of discovered secret locations.
